title: The Code Snippets WordPress plugin before 4.1.0 does not verify network-level capabilities before honouring a…
description: The Code Snippets WordPress plugin versions prior to 4.1.0 have a vulnerability in multisite environments where network-level capability checks are not performed on snippet import routes. This allows a subsite administrator without network-management rights to create, overwrite, or deactivate network-wide snippets affecting the entire network.
